brief.t: Top lane today: lock the Talova reorder with Marcello. Coco Vanilla went viral, he wants back in, only blocker is confirming we got Kenna's revisions.
Amanda from Riley's referral, twenty five hundred to three thousand units. Reply is drafted and Teams is fixed, ready to send with your booking link.
Mark Higgins call was yesterday morning. Need the outcome so we can build his quote today.
Four real thousand-plus brands still never quoted: Ethnic Gals, Rannah Aytay, Emma Wagyu, and Victor. Quoting is the leak, not demand.
Calendly Teams conferencing is now connected. Future bookings generate a real join link. Still need to backfill links on calls already booked.
Open question for Sam: an unrecognized Geo ad campaign showed up in last night's Ads report. Confirm if you authorized it or it gets paused.

Say SEND for Amanda — I fire the reply-all with booking link

Yes/no on the Geo ad campaign

kb.a: Oreka is an $8,555 closed deal already in production. Laura owns customer communication. It is a production follow-through item, not a new-sales chase.

Pure Good is roughly a $329,000 opportunity tied to the same Kenna meeting gate. It advances when the Kenna follow-up is resolved and a next commercial step is scheduled. Do not present it as closed or production-ready.

A Spanish-speaking website lead wants 100 units of a 1.7-ounce custom cream with retinol, hyaluronic acid, collagen, and niacinamide. Sam already replied, and the open loop is a price. Provide pricing to close the conversation without overstating a commitment.

Nikkie Aroh starts full time on August 31 to run Outbound Sales daily. She is already responding to inbound white-label inquiries from her PLL email, with Sam copied; the Aug 30 Outbound AI finder run is the day-one pipeline setup.

The Production Pipeline CRM build is approved and queued for execution. It should be executed only when Sam says go. The CRM session is currently logged out, so live verification remains blocked until Sam restores it.

WhatsApp and the CRM are both logged out today. Restoring WhatsApp unblocks the client sweep and Terra Lotus follow-up; restoring CRM access unblocks fix verification and operational lookup. Neither session should be described as connected until reauthenticated.

Laura owns Oreka customer communications, white/private-label bottle-printing coordination, and NDAs. Her simpler dedicated assistant is built, but her email, WhatsApp, and CRM connections still await Sam's setup. Keep her focused on active customer operations and documentation.

Ronald supplies formula and BOM cost inputs where needed. His costing work must include the requested inputs before any quote is issued, and no quote should rely on a BOM alone. There is no new Ronald completion recorded in this refresh.
Darlene Saintil's luxury hand-lotion and hand-wash discovery meeting was scheduled for August 19. No meeting outcome is recorded in this refresh, so do not present a next step as confirmed.

Tesfa Shiferaw at Bahrzaf has an active shampoo-and-conditioner project; the previously scheduled Monday conversation has no recorded outcome in this refresh. Keep the project in follow-up rather than claiming a completed meeting.
Ashley Harmon at Apothik wants a call today at 2:30 or 3 PM Eastern, or Monday. Sam should pick a slot; the Consultant will book it, and it should not be described as booked before that choice.

Tasnim Broud at AYYUR is considering a ritual-oil package with a 30 mL frosted glass bottle and gold dropper/cap. She is open to PLL sourcing and has not selected a vendor. The commercial path is to move toward prototype quantities once packaging direction is confirmed.

Nabil Saleh at CN1 Fragrance is interested in 4,000-plus eight-ounce tubes of scented body lotion using his own fragrance oil. The next qualification points are formula, tube packaging, and timing. No new response is recorded in this refresh.

Talova Labs is the warmest money lane today: Marcello wants the Coco Vanilla reorder after it went viral and wants back in. The only blocker is confirming that PLL received Kenna's revisions. Sam should lock Marcello once that confirmation is in.

Max at Delphos House previously proposed an August 18 launch-strategy call, but it was not confirmed and no outcome is recorded here. Aidan's raw-materials answer remains a separate Delphos follow-up.

Dan Hunter at Hunter Amenities wants to meet next Wednesday after inbound interest through James Pitenis. The retail and airline-amenities channel could bring real volume, but units are not qualified yet.

Emma Garrison at Wagyu Wellness submitted a new Shopify contact-form inquiry on August 17. It has not been qualified against the 1,000-plus-unit ICP, so complete the size check before investing further time.
No CRM Developer replies arrived overnight. There is no new developer status to read back, so keep the CRM fix state unchanged until a reply is received and verified.
Delizioso Skincare's NDA is confirmed. The relationship is moving forward; no additional delivery or timing detail is recorded in this refresh.
An overnight Huntington alert showed a $10,000 item plus a $5,000 ACH/withdrawal. It is flagged to Sam for confirmation and is likely normal supplier or payroll activity, but it remains unconfirmed.

Sam’s first lane is the 9:30 AM ET Mark Higgins qualify call: confirm units per SKU, budget, and timeline. Then get Lisa’s order 1467 status and reply today, test the Calendly-to-Teams flow, confirm Terra Lotus shipment, and decide the Ads and staged-build queue.

Aidan is driving Atlas Eternal’s $26,500 production across four lanes and coordinating Terra Lotus’s 19,000-unit R&D shipment checkpoint. Atlas has $13,250 due on completion; Terra requires confirmation that Shampoo 5K, Body Wash 9K, and Conditioner 5K sample sets shipped.

Atlas Eternal is a $26,500 production project with Aidan driving four lanes. The remaining $13,250 balance is due on completion; keep the handoffs moving and collect the balance when production is complete.

Terra Lotus has three R&D sample sets due around August 24: Shampoo 5K, Body Wash 9K, and Conditioner 5K, totaling 19,000 units. Shipment is not confirmed until all three sets are verified; the revised quote waits for BOMs and Sam’s sign-off.

Lisa Christensen’s order 1467 still shows not shipped after 10-plus days, although she received an on-its-way email. The live status needs checking and Laura owns an honest customer reply today; shipment is not confirmed from the email alone.

Calendly Teams conferencing is now connected, so future bookings generate a real join link. Backfill the links on the already booked Connor Sousa and Ari Levitin calls. Do not call the older bookings fixed until those links are updated.

Mark Higgins's call happened yesterday morning, August 24. The outcome is not yet recorded, so Sam needs to report it before the quote is built today. Do not treat the quote as ready until that outcome is known.

The Geo Twin, PLL-Search-ContractMfg-2026 #2, was re-enabled and spent $10.12 on August 23 after zero spend August 20–22. Sam must decide whether to pause it or keep it in the Manual-CPC plan; the main campaigns remain on Maximize Conversions pending approval.
The ConvertFlow two-branch fork and Shopify floating Call/Book widget are staged on drafts, with the live site untouched. Sam’s approval is still required before either build is published.

Kari Naughton is booked for an August 26 chemist call about a four-SKU scalp system. The prior booking-link failure makes end-to-end link testing a prerequisite for treating the appointment as secure.
Gridlot, represented by Yianni Koutsos, is booked for an August 27 call about a beef-tallow line. The opportunity is still in qualification, including unit volume and commercial fit.
Amanda came through Riley's referral for 2,500 to 3,000 units. The reply-all is drafted, Teams conferencing is fixed, and it is ready to send with Sam's booking link.
An unrecognized Geo ad campaign appeared in last night's Ads report. Sam must confirm whether it was authorized; if not, it should be paused. No authorization or pause is recorded yet.
